messages:
tom_sales: Dropped the ORION pen-test bundle in the secure bucket. Customer asks for full evidence + timelines. Link: https://secure.redwood.example/orion/1991234567 :paperclip:
compliance_bot: Uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-secure/orion/1991234567/ 
  - report: orion-pt-report.pdf
  - artifacts: vuln-scan-xml.zip
  - poc-archive: pocs.tar.gz
  - manifest: orion-manifest.json
  - sha256: orion-1991234567.sha256
rebecca_se: we need to strip any customer-identifying data and internal hostnames before handing over. Legal wants no cleartext emails or SAML tokens in PoCs.
dana_eng: agree. I'll run the scrubber and generate redacted PoCs. Suggest we replace runnable exploit binaries with pseudo-code snippets and step-by-step repro notes instead of raw binaries.
nish_ciso: Sounds good. For triage we need CVSS, attack complexity, and whether exploit is authenticated. Also propose remediation SLA: 7 days for criticals, 21 for high, 45 for medium/low backlog.
tom_sales: ORION asked for a 30-day window. I'll push back with our proposed SLA above and offer a hotfix cadence if they accept faster timelines.
rebecca_se: posted redact script: `tools/redact_poC.sh` — usage: `./redact_poC.sh pocs.tar.gz > pocs-redacted.tar.gz`. It strips IPs and removes any files >5MB that look like binaries.
dana_eng: ran redact, replaced hostnames with <REDACTED_HOST>, stripped creds, and converted binary PoCs to pseudo-PoCs. Uploaded to s3://redwood-secure/orion/1991234567/redacted/ and updated manifest.
compliance_bot: Audit record: redacted bundle created by dana_eng at 1991264800. Link expiry: 21 days. sha256: 9f7e2c... orion-redacted-1991234567.sha256
nish_ciso: Conditions for release: (1) redacted bundle only unless NDA addendum is signed; (2) remediation timeline in writing; (3) designate a security liaison (we'll use security@redwood.com). I can approve sharing under those terms.
rebecca_se: I'll attach our one-page Risk Acceptance template and a short runbook with mitigation steps for the high items. Also include workaround config flags.
dana_eng: opened ticket RW-7112 to track fixes (auth-service and rate-limiter). ETA: critical patch in 5 business days, mitigations in 2 days. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-7112
tom_sales: I'll send a concise email to ORION security once Nish confirms. Proposed share date for redacted artifacts: 1991290000 (tomorrow EOD). Proposed initial mitigation deploy: 1991320000. Full patch rollout target: 1991600000.
nish_ciso: OK to proceed. If ORION insists on raw PoCs without NDA addendum, escalate to legal and deny direct binary delivery. Also request signed acknowledgement of SLA.
rebecca_se: note: ORION asked for a weekly status digest. Recommend weekly sync + a one-page progress tracker we update each Friday.
dana_eng: adding automated scrub step to the artifact ingestion pipeline as an action item. Will follow up in eng-ops.
tom_sales: thanks team. Rebecca — can you prepare the email and include the redacted manifest + CVSS table? I'll loop in ORION and product ops.
rebecca_se: will do and will CC nish_ciso and dana_eng. sending when audit shows redacted bundle active. :thumbsup:
compliance_bot: Notification posted: redacted bundle shared with security contact at orion-corp.com (pending acceptance).
